title: Korean Roasted Fromage Anju
description: A simple, comforting Korean-inspired anju recipe that combines roasted fromage with spices, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the Korean chili flakes, brown sugar, and garlic powder.
Toss the fromage cubes with the spice mixture until evenly coated.
Transfer the fromage to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the top of the fromage with sesame oil.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the fromage is golden brown and caramelized.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro (if using).
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
